content: Hanʉ gayo gaahitirɨ, nɨkarekera amɨɨsʉ nɨkarora maraika ʉwʉndɨ ariika kurwa mwisaarʉ. Aarɨ nʉ ʉbhʉnaja bhʉkʉrʉ, nɨ ɨɨsɨ ɨkabhanza nu ubhwɨrʉ bhwazɨ.

content.text: Rʉbhɨɨrɨ nɨ‑hagero hi ibhinyunyi ibhibhuruuru bhyu ukwigatanʼya.
Rugwirɨ kʉ kʉbha abhaatʉ bhi ibhyarʉ bhyʉsi
bhagwatirwɨ ne ebhoono ɨhaari yɨ ɨtaarʉ yaazɨ
bhakaniibha igʉrʉ wu ubhwaru bhwi ikiniibhʉ chazɨ.”

content: Neho nikiigwa riraka ɨrɨndɨ kurwa kwisaarʉ, rɨrabhuga,

content.text: korereke mʉtagwatana nawe kokora ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwazɨ
Chɨmbu aabhakʉrɨɨrɨ abhandɨ, na niimwɨ momokorere muyomuyo.
Na akorerwe manga abhɨrɨ ya amabhɨ ganʉ aabhakʉrɨɨrɨ abhandɨ.
mʉmʉtʉʉrɨrɨmu manga kabhɨrɨ yʉ ʉbhʉhaari bhʉnʉ aabhakʉrɨɨrɨ.
Momohe ɨnyaakʉ nʉ ʉbhʉrʉrʉ chɨmbu akwiheema,
kʉrɨngʼaana nu ubhwikari bhwazɨ bhwa mangʼana ga kʉʉsɨ.
Igʉrʉ wa gayo arabhona amacha gʉʉsi rusikʉ rʉmwɨ,
amacha gu uruku, gɨ ɨkɨrɨrʉ na gɨ ɨnzara.
kʉ kʉbha Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Mungu wʉnʉ akʉmʉtɨnɨra anʉ ʉbhʉnaja.”

content: Abhatɨmi bhɨ ɨɨsɨ bhanʉ bhakosebheeta nawe na kugwatana ubhuniibhi bhwazɨ, bhararɨra na kwarama ʉrʉbhɨri rurya hanʉ bharaarore umwʉki gu ukurika kwawe.
Bhariimɨɨrɨra kore nʉ ʉrʉbhɨri ruyo ku kwʉbhaha ɨnyaakʉ yaazɨ. Bhararɨra bharabhuga, “Horeera, horeera ʉrʉbhɨri ʉrʉkʉrʉ Bhaabhɨɨri, ʉrʉbhɨri rwa amanaga! Ɨtɨnɨrʉ yaazʉ ihikirɨ kwa bhwangʉ bhʉkʉngʼu.”
Abhasuruja bha kʉʉsɨ bharamʉrɨrɨra na kumwaramɨra, kʉ kʉbha bhatareeho abhaatʉ bhʉ ʉkʉgʉra ebhegero bhyabhʉ.

Atareeho ʉmʉʉtʉ naatu wʉ ʉkʉgʉra ebhegero bhyabhʉ bhyɨ ɨzahaabhu, zimpirya, ruuru na amabhwɨ gu ubhwera. Atareeho ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉ ʉkʉgʉra zengebho zɨnzʉmu za zambaraawɨ, za hariri na zi imbiriiri. Atareeho ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉ ʉkʉgʉra ebhegero bhyɨ ɨmɨtɨ ju ubhwera, nʉʉrʉ ebhegero bhɨnʉ bhɨkʉrirwɨ na zehembe, bhya amatɨ ga riguri, nʉʉrʉ bhyɨ ɨshabha, ichʉma hamwɨ marumaru.

Atareeho ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉ ʉkʉgʉra ʉmʉdarasiini, ɨbhɨrʉngʉ, umurumbasʉ, manɨmanɨ, nʉʉrʉ idivaayi, amaguta gʉ ʉmʉzɨyituuni, ubhutu ubhwɨrʉ nɨ ɨnganʉ. Na atareeho ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉ ʉkʉgʉra zengʼombe, zɨngʼʉndu, zɨfaraasi, zɨtʉrʉʉri yu ukurutwa na zɨfaraasi, bhambʉʉsa nʉʉrʉ ubhwikari bhwa abhaatʉ.
Abhasuruja bharabhuga, “Ebhegero bhɨnʉ waarɨ ukwigomba bhʉkʉngʼu bhiruureho. Bhyʉsi bhyɨ ɨkɨtɨrɨɨganʉ na bhyi ikiniibhi bhibhurirɨ. Bhɨtareeho na ʉtakʉtʉra kobhebhona kwikɨ.”
Abhasuruja bhanʉ bhakaniibha kwewe, bhariimɨɨrɨra kore ku ukwʉbhaha ɨnyaakʉ yaazɨ, bharaarama na kʉrɨra.
Bharabhuga, “Horeera, horeera, icharʉ ɨkɨkʉrʉ! Waarɨ wiibhʉhirɨ zengebho zɨnzʉmu bhʉkʉngʼu, za zambaraawɨ na zi imbiriiri. Waarɨ uriitonera kʉzahaabhu, amabhwɨ gu ubhwera ni iruuru.

Nawe ubhuniibhi bhuyo bhwʉsi bhurikiibhwɨ kwa bhwangʉ bhʉkʉngʼu.” Abhakʉrʉ bhʉʉsi bhu ubhwatʉ, abhagɨndi bhʉʉsi, abhakangati bhu ubhwatʉ, na abhahocha bhe emeremo bhʉʉsi bhu ubhwatʉ, bhariimɨɨrɨra kore.
Hanʉ bhaarʉʉzɨ umwʉki gwu ukurika kwawe, bhakarɨra kwiraka bharabhuga, “Rʉtareeho ʉrʉbhɨri ʉrʉndɨ nchʉ ʉrʉbhɨri ʉrʉkʉrʉ rʉnʉ!”

Bhakarɨra na kwarama, bhakiiyitɨrɨra urutu kumitwɨ na kʉgamba, “Horeera, horeera, ʉrʉbhɨri ʉrʉkʉrʉ! Rʉkatokora itwʉsi bhu ubhwatʉ tʉbhɨ abhaniibhi igʉrʉ wu ubhuniibhi bhwazɨ. Nawe ʉrʉbhɨri rwʉsi rurikirɨ kwa bhwangʉ bhʉkʉngʼu.”
Mozomerwe igʉrʉ waazɨ, imwɨ bhanʉ mukwikara mwisaarʉ. Mozomerwe abharɨndu bha Mungu, abhatumwa na abharʉʉtɨrɨri, kʉ kʉbha Mungu atiniirɨ ʉrʉbhɨri ruyo kʉgarya rwabhakʉrɨɨrɨ.
Akʉmara maraika wʉmwɨ wa amanaga, akanʉnga riibhwɨ ryangɨ ʉrʉbhwɨ, akarɨtaasha mʉnyanza, akabhuga,

content.text: ʉrʉbhɨri ʉrʉkʉrʉ rwa Bhaabhɨɨri rʉrataashibhwa na kʉbhʉra kɨmwɨ.
na kʉtakʉbha ni iraka rya mukwɨri nʉʉrʉ rya muryakari.
bhɨkangiriibhwɨ nʉ ʉbhʉrʉgi bhwʉ ʉrʉbhɨri ruyo.
Mʉrʉbhɨri muyo gakarorekana amasaahɨ ga abharʉʉtɨrɨri
na amasaahɨ ga abharɨndu bha Mungu,
hamwɨmwɨ na amasaahɨ ga abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhiitirwɨ kʉʉsɨ.”

footnotes.text: Bhaabhɨɨri rwarɨ ʉrʉbhɨri kʉʉsɨ ya Mesopotaamiya. Abhaatʉ bhʉ ʉrʉbhɨri ruyo bhaarɨ bharasengera amasambwa na amabhirʉbhirʉ. Rora Danyɨri 3:5‑7. Mʉkɨtabhʉ chu Ubhwɨrɨkibhwa, Bhaabhɨɨri iriimɨɨrɨrɨra abhabhisa bhʉʉsi bha Mungu. Rora Ubhwɨrɨkibhwa 14:8, 16:19, 17:5.
